source_checks.finding: The new bound is validated before cached or streaming reads. Actual non-empty streamed bytes are accumulated, the first crossing raises before appending that chunk, and _body is assigned only after successful completion. Cached lower bounds reject without rereceiving. Existing json and stream implementations are otherwise unchanged.
The public error inherits HTTPException, fixes status 413 and the requested detail, and preserves the limit/received attributes.

Only bounded HTTP requests buffer. Oversize handling occurs before downstream invocation; the downstream call is outside the RequestBodyTooLarge catch, preserving endpoint exceptions. Accepted bytes replay once, then every subsequent receive delegates to the original channel.
Documentation matches the requested disabled/default limits, actual-byte counting, error, partial-stream and replay behavior.

Added tests exercise original integration fixtures and both asynchronous backends rather than replacing existing tests. Exact base inventory comparison confirms no existing test/configuration was changed.
